newsitem.title: USA: Phillips, McMoRan Bay Junop well has problems.
newsitem.headline: Phillips, McMoRan Bay Junop well has problems.

text.p: McMoRan Oil & Gas Co said the A-1 S/T No. 2 well in the south Terrebone Parish, La., Bay Junop prospect, has experienced mechanical difficulties which have resulted in delays in drilling the well to test the primary objective sands which lie in an interval from 15,000 feet to 19,500 feet total depth.
The well is currently drilling at approximately 14,350 feet, McMoRan said.
Phillips Petroleum is operator of the prospect, with a 50 percent working interest. Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP and McMoRan Oil own 25 percent each.
